topPRs.title: Add Unichain mainnet PAO transition tasks (eth/069-070)
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Transitions the Unichain Mainnet (chainId 130) ProxyAdmin Owner to the standard OP-governed model per the [governance post](https://app.notion.com/p/oplabs/EXTERNAL-Maintenance-Upgrade-Proposal-Unichain-ProxyAdmin-Owner-Transition-to-Standard-Optimism-Go-381f153ee16281efad21c307cef7c928): eth/069 transfers the L1 `ProxyAdmin` and `DisputeGameFactory` from the Unichain 3-of-3 to the standard L1PAO (`TransferOwners`), then eth/070 moves the L2 `ProxyAdmin` predeploy to the aliased L1PAO via a portal deposit sent by the 3-of-3 (`TransferL2PAOFromL1`). Same flow as eth/063/064 on Swell, signed by the 3-of-3's `chain-governor`/`foundation`/`council` child safes. Both tasks are DRAFT until the special voting cycle and veto period complete; all addresses are sourced from the superchain-registry (links in the task docs).

Everything else on Unichain is already standard or out of scope: Guardian, Challenger and SuperchainConfig are the OP Mainnet ones, DelayedWETH is post-U16 and not ownable, and the SystemConfig owner stays with the operator per the governance post. Sepolia is covered by the same proposal but not part of this PR.

Two drive-bys: eth/065 is marked EXECUTED ([tx](https://etherscan.io/tx/0xbf75cc41981ecb8481f3b114697310490b72f96c74fcc34e33b57433b6d9e756)) — its stale READY-TO-SIGN status broke the eth stacked simulation — and `docs/simulate-l2-ownership-transfer.md` step 9 now shows the correct example `From` address.

Note: the FUS/SC nonce pins overlap with #1521 (both stack after eth/066); whichever set of tasks signs second must re-pin and re-simulate.

topPRs.title: feat: enforce V800 task validation in template
topPRs.author: jelias2
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- enforce OPCM 8.0.x and reject pre-registered ZK game type
- validate Portal, SystemConfig, SuperchainConfig, ProxyAdmin, DGF, guardian, and root Safe relationships
- derive expected validator errors from live state
- ignore obsolete Netchef validation fields for legacy TOML compatibility

## Stack

Stacked on #1528 because V800 template does not exist on main yet. This patch must land before Netchef removes V800 inspection.

## Testing

- forge test --offline --match-path test/template/OPCMUpgradeV800Preconditions.t.sol -vv
- forge fmt --check

12 focused tests pass.

topPRs.title: Add Unichain Sepolia PAO transition tasks (sep/107-108)
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Sepolia half of the Unichain PAO transfer. Both tasks are DRAFT since they are a reference for Unichain to execute the transfers on their end: 

- **sep/107** transfers the L1 `ProxyAdmin` and `DisputeGameFactory` from the Unichain Sepolia Safe to the standard Sepolia L1PAO (`TransferOwners`)
- **sep/108** transfers the L2 `ProxyAdmin` predeploy to the aliased L1PAO via a portal deposit sent by the same Safe (`TransferL2PAOFromL1`)


| Contract | Owner before | Owner after |
|---|---|---|
| `ProxyAdmin` `0x2BF403E5353A7a082ef6bb3Ae2Be3B866D8D3ea4` | `0xd363339eE47775888Df411A163c586a8BdEA9dbf` (Unichain Sepolia Safe) | `0x1Eb2fFc903729a0F03966B917003800b145F56E2` (Sepolia L1PAO) |
| `DisputeGameFactoryProxy` `0xeff73e5aa3B9AEC32c659Aa3E00444d20a84394b` | `0xd363339eE47775888Df411A163c586a8BdEA9dbf` (Unichain Sepolia Safe) | `0x1Eb2fFc903729a0F03966B917003800b145F56E2` (Sepolia L1PAO) |
| L2 `ProxyAdmin` `0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000018` | `0xe474339ee47775888df411A163c586a8bDEaaEd0` (aliased Safe) | `0x2FC3ffc903729a0f03966b917003800B145F67F3` (aliased L1PAO) |

Other roles addresses on Unichain Sepolia are already standard/out of scope: Guardian and SuperchainConfig are the OP Sepolia ones, DelayedWETH is post-U16 and not ownable and the Challenger and SystemConfig owner are Unichain-operated Safes that stay with the operator.

Mainnet transfer: #1527
